bumpRationale: Adds a test-data seeder (src/lib/testData/ + ADMIN-only SeedTestData page) that generates a connected, role-isolated sample dataset across all entities via the app SDK so Base44 tags it is_sample:true (hidden when Test Data is off). Pure blueprint + isolation model + applier, with an integrity/role-isolation test suite and a report/pre-mortem doc. Additive dev/admin tooling; no change to existing user-facing flows.

assistantSkills.note: The sibling claude-skills repo holds 48 generic Anthropic/Claude authoring skills (pdf, xlsx, brainstorming, math-olympiad, ...). They are assistant tooling used to BUILD Liuma — NOT features of the application, not integrated into it, and not listed in the user manual.
